classification.difficultyReason: Every part is signposted. Parts a and b are direct differentiation of recalled formulas (A=πr², V=4/3πr³), then recognising the results as the circumference and S. Part c is a 'hence' chain-rule step with the target given. Part d is one substitution with no hidden setup. The hardest demand is the small interpretive link (dV/dr = S) plus recalling the sphere formulas, which is slightly above the p10-q1 related-rates chain, where the setup is just A=x². It is still direct application, with no modelling of a new situation and no multi-step linking, so it sits below the routine linked procedures of A3.
